coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell or box: its printed edges. Tick box: the printed square.
how_measured: pdfplumber characters, drawn rules and rectangles of the PDF (cand/b105.json); box characters measured as ink on a 400 dpi render; row cells measured between the row rules from caption to caption; every page looked at at 90 dpi; overlays looked at.

third_parties: broker-dealer, financial advisor and branch manager (page 4)
signing.kind: Subscription agreement form (Oaktree REIT, Appendix C). The investor completes sections 1-5 and 7-8 and signs page 7; a co-investor (or custodian) signs beside; the investor and co-investor each initial 27 representations; the broker-dealer section and its two signatures are on page 4. No issuer acceptance block.

sure_per_page.2: sure of every place; boxes of row cells run from caption to next caption (no vertical rules are printed); the co-investor citizenship place has no printed rule
sure_per_page.3: sure; the last row (ABA/account) has no rule under it: its band is taken as 17 pt like the row above
sure_per_page.4: sure; the Section 6 cells have irregular rules (row 1 has a rule only under the right half): boxes taken between the nearest rules
sure_per_page.5: sure; whose the second box of each pair is (co-investor) is a judgement
sure_per_page.6: sure; whose the second box of each pair is (co-investor) is a judgement
sure_per_page.7: sure; the second signature is captioned "co-investor or custodian"

the underline of "pre-printed voided check" (underlined words)
